meta.title: 旅行出片第一步，原地坐下！
meta.title_en: The First Step to Great Travel Shots: Sit Down!

scenes.context: 旅行中精疲力尽时遇到一把椅子，结果它是会偷手机的小偷——其实是长焦镜头的剧情演绎。
sentences: 旅行中千万要小心这样的椅子，尤其在你精疲力尽的时候。
Watch out for chairs like this on trips, especially when you're exhausted.
beware the chair（小心椅子）
因为它很可能是……一个会偷手机的小偷。
Because it might be... a phone-snatching thief.
phone snatcher（偷手机贼）
一部手机，再偷一下另一边，一根铁棒——是三摄镜头了。
A phone, another grab, a bar—wait, it's the three-lens camera.
three-lens camera（三摄镜头）
scenes.speak: Watch out for chairs like this on trips, especially when you're exhausted. Because it might be... a phone-snatching thief. A phone, another grab, a bar—wait, it's the three-lens camera.

scenes.context: 400毫米长焦加三颗大师定焦镜头，原地获得不同景别，还能拼出趣味画面。
sentences: 这台VIVO X300 Ultra加上400毫米长焦，也是王炸组合。
This Vivo X300 Ultra plus 400mm telephoto is a killer combo.
killer combo（王炸组合）
真的是一目千里。
You can really see a mile away.
see a mile away（一目千里）
搭配它本来的三颗大师定焦镜头，原地轻松获得不同景别。
With its three master prime lenses, you get different framings on the spot.
different framings（不同景别）
我甚至可以这样拼到一起。
I can even stitch them together.
stitch together（拼接）
paraphrase: see a mile away（一目千里
see a mile away（一目千里
scenes.speak: This Vivo X300 Ultra plus 400mm telephoto is a killer combo. You can really see a mile away. With its three master prime lenses, you get different framings on the spot. I can even stitch them together.

scenes.context: 为什么画面有故事感？因为慢——4K120帧能把旅行中的情绪放大，抓住转瞬即逝的细节。
sentences: 为什么看起来都这么有故事感？因为慢。
Why do these look so cinematic? Because they're slow.
cinematic（故事感）
全焦段4K120帧，能将旅行中的情绪放大。
Full-range 4K at 120fps amplifies travel emotions.
amplify emotions（放大情绪）
所有转瞬即逝、来不及追赶的细节，我坐在原地就一网打尽。
Every fleeting detail I'd miss, I catch while sitting still.
fleeting details（转瞬即逝的细节）
scenes.speak: Why do these look so cinematic? Because they're slow. Full-range 4K at 120fps amplifies travel emotions. Every fleeting detail I'd miss, I catch while sitting still.

scenes.context: 手机也能拍10bit Log，有足够空间按天气情绪调色，还能现场用平板演示。
sentences: 这可是手机呀，你的颜色怎么可以这么好？
This is a phone—how can its colors be this good?
great colors（颜色优秀）
这台手机所有的规格都可以拍10bit Log。
Every spec of this phone can record 10-bit Log.
10-bit Log（十比特Log）
有足够的空间根据天气、情绪、场景调出对应的风格。
Enough headroom to grade by weather, mood, and scene.
grading headroom（调色空间）
我可以直接用这台Vivo Pad 6 Pro现场调给你看。
I can grade it live on this Vivo Pad 6 Pro.
grade on site（现场调色）
scenes.speak: This is a phone—how can its colors be this good? Every spec of this phone can record 10-bit Log. Enough headroom to grade by weather, mood, and scene. I can grade it live on this Vivo Pad 6 Pro.

scenes.context: 不会调色也能原地出片：一个Film Look滤镜直接获得电影感。
sentences: 不会调色，但想直接电影感，怎么办？
Can't color grade but want the film look right away?
film look（电影感）
正好可以让大家感受一下Film Look滤镜的美丽。
Perfect—let everyone feel the beauty of the Film Look filter.
Film Look filter（电影感滤镜）
不会调色，也可以原地出片了。
Even without grading skills, you get cinematic results instantly.
instant cinematic（立刻出片）
scenes.speak: Can't color grade but want the film look right away? Perfect—let everyone feel the beauty of the Film Look filter. Even without grading skills, you get cinematic results instantly.

scenes.context: 朋友要求近景特写，两亿像素人像随意裁切放大依然清晰。
sentences: 人家要近的，我看你咋拍呀。
They want a close-up—how are you going to shoot that?
close-up（特写）
两亿人像随意裁切，你可以拉大变成特写。
200MP portraits crop freely; zoom in for a close-up.
200MP（两亿像素）
在这个像素下，主体放在不同位置都很清晰。
At this resolution, the subject stays sharp at any position.
stay sharp（保持清晰）
原地拍一张，等于好几张。
One shot equals several.
one for several（一图多用）
scenes.speak: They want a close-up—how are you going to shoot that? 200MP portraits crop freely; zoom in for a close-up. At this resolution, the subject stays sharp at any position. One shot equals several.

practice: A 400mm telephoto plus primes gives flexible framings.
4K120fps amplifies emotions and catches fleeting details.
10-bit Log on a phone leaves headroom for grading.
A Film Look filter gives cinematic results instantly.
pitfalls: Think only cinema cameras grade in Log.
This phone shoots 10-bit Log across all specs.
4K120fps slow motion catches them from your seat.
Assume you must learn color grading.
A Film Look filter delivers cinematic tones instantly.
Forget flexible framing on a phone.
Three primes plus long telephoto cover many framings.
200MP lets you crop freely into sharp close-ups.
shifts: 用 400mm zoom（400毫米长焦）、prime lenses（定焦镜头）、stitch shots（拼接画面）
说慢动作只会说 slow motion
用 4K120fps、amplify emotions（放大情绪）、fleeting details（转瞬即逝的细节）
说调色只会说 color grade
用 10-bit Log、Film Look filter（电影感滤镜）、grade on site（现场调色）
